about_the_game:
Evil creatures are crawling out from the depths, and your castle stands as the last bastion of hope! In Poly Lands, you’ll battle relentless waves of enemies across vibrant low-poly worlds, using towers, troops, spells, and heroes to forge your perfect defense.

Build, upgrade, and adapt your strategy to withstand the onslaught. Summon brave warriors to hold the line, unleash devastating magic, and command powerful heroes with unique abilities. Each level brings new challenges and quests, testing your skill and creativity as you defend the realm.

Key Features

  • Epic tower defense battles with waves of relentless enemies.

  • Build, upgrade, and destroy towers to shape your strategy.

  • Command troops and heroes with unique abilities to turn the tide of battle.

  • Unleash powerful spells to crush your foes when the pressure rises.

  • Diverse enemies and tactics that keep every wave unpredictable.

  • Engaging quests to complete as you progress through levels.

  • Vibrant low-poly style that makes every battlefield a colorful adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 940MX
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5/i7 (10th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 7/9
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Defend your castle from waves of enemies spilling out of dark caves! Build and upgrade turrets, summon troops, unleash powerful spells, and lead heroes with unique abilities. Adapt your strategy in vibrant low-poly worlds where every battle tests your skill!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
